verdict.rationale: SumUp documents an official managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp that lets MCP clients manage the account, create checkouts and process payments via the Cloud API. Its docs also describe connecting AI assistants through this server and an Agent Toolkit with MCP support, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, documented authentication/setup details and a full tool list for the MCP endpoint.
